name: Trusting In Prayer
overview: Scripture reveals that trusting in prayer is fundamentally about placing unwavering confidence in the Lord’s strength and protection, as seen in Psalms 28:7 where trust leads to help and rejoicing. Believers are encouraged to dwell securely under God’s care (Psalms 91:1) and to maintain a heart fixed on Him without fear of adversity (Psalms 112:7). This trust involves surrendering our own understanding in favor of reliance on God’s wisdom (Proverbs 3:5), and it is expressed through faith even in moments of doubt, as exemplified by the pleas for belief in Mark 5:36 and Mark 9:24.
